run_on_destroy_test_case: run the CTestCase on_run_case to test WASM app install, request, and uninstall lifecycle
test_install_and_uninstall_app: test installing a WASM app with install_app then uninstalling it with uninstall_app
test_send_request_and_check_response: test sending a GET request to a WASM app endpoint and checking the response payload
test_query_apps_after_lifecycle: test querying installed apps after install and uninstall to verify the app list
review_CTestCase_on_run_case: review the CTestCase on_run_case method to understand the WASM component on-destroy lifecycle test flow
